llms.body:
# Uppsala University

> Uppsala University (Uppsala universitet) is Sweden's oldest and one of Scandinavia's leading research universities, founded in 1477. Located in Uppsala, Sweden, with a second campus in Visby (Gotland), the university offers world-class education and research across humanities, social sciences, law, medicine, pharmacy, and science and technology. With approximately 50,000 registered students, 7,539 employees, and 16 Nobel Prize laureates among its alumni, Uppsala University consistently ranks among the global top 100. Its mission is to conduct education and research of the highest quality and relevance to make a long-term difference in society.

Uppsala University is a comprehensive public research university governed by the Swedish state. It is organised into three disciplinary domains — Humanities and Social Sciences, Medicine and Pharmacy, and Science and Technology — comprising nine faculties and approximately 60 departments. The university motto is "Gratiae veritas naturae" (Truth in the grace of nature). The Vice-Chancellor is Anders Hagfeldt. Key historic figures associated with Uppsala include Carl Linnaeus (taxonomy), Anders Celsius (temperature scale), Svante Arrhenius (Nobel Prize in Chemistry 1903), and Dag Hammarskjöld (Nobel Peace Prize 1961). Svante Pääbo (Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine 2022) is a notable alumnus. The university is ranked #87 in the QS World University Rankings 2027. Annual turnover is SEK 9,235 million; approximately 58% of research funding comes from external sources. The university trains more than 3,000 physicians, nurses and medical staff annually in cooperation with Uppsala University Hospital (Akademiska sjukhuset).

Uppsala University Library, founded in 1620, is Sweden's largest research library with 11 subject libraries including Carolina Rediviva. The university hosts several museums open to the public: the Museum of Evolution (over 5 million natural history specimens), Gustavianum (Uppsala University Museum, with Egyptian mummies, Viking-era artefacts, the Augsburg Art Cabinet and an anatomical theatre from 1663), the Museum of Medical History, and the Linnaeus Museum. The Linnaeus Garden and Botanical Garden are connected to the university's Linnaean heritage. The student nation system — unique student organisations with social and welfare functions — is a centuries-old Uppsala tradition.

## About the University

- [About Uppsala University](https://www.uu.se/en/about-uu): Overview of history, mission, and organisation.
- [Facts and figures](https://www.uu.se/en/about-uu/facts-and-figures): Key statistics on students, staff, finances, and research output.
- [History](https://www.uu.se/en/about-uu/history): From founding in 1477 to present day, including Nobel laureates.
- [Vision, goals and strategies](https://www.uu.se/en/about-uu/vision-goals-and-strategies): The university's long-term strategic direction.
- [Structure and governance](https://www.uu.se/en/about-uu/structure-and-governance): University Board, Vice-Chancellor, disciplinary domains, and faculties.
- [Sustainable development](https://www.uu.se/en/about-uu/sustainable-development): Uppsala University's commitment to the UN Sustainable Development Goals.
- [Academic traditions](https://www.uu.se/en/about-uu/academic-traditions): Student nations, degree ceremonies, and other Uppsala traditions.
- [The University area](https://www.uu.se/en/about-uu/the-university-area): Buildings, campuses, and the physical environment in Uppsala and Visby.
- [Rankings](https://www.uu.se/en/about-uu/rankings): Uppsala University in the latest global university rankings.
- [Join us (work here)](https://www.uu.se/en/about-uu/join-us): Jobs, vacancies, and information for prospective employees.
- [HR Excellence in Research](https://www.uu.se/en/about-uu/join-us/hr-excellence-in-research): European Commission award for research work environment.
- [Contact and organisation](https://www.uu.se/en/contact-and-organisation): Directory of faculties, departments, units, and staff.
- [Data protection policy](https://www.uu.se/en/about-uu/data-protection-policy): How Uppsala University processes personal data (GDPR).
- [Support Uppsala University](https://www.uu.se/en/support-uppsala-university): Donations and philanthropic giving.

## Study

- [Study at Uppsala University](https://www.uu.se/en/study): Overview of all study opportunities — bachelor's, master's, exchange and freestanding courses.
- [Master's studies](https://www.uu.se/en/study/masters-studies): Information about Uppsala's approximately 100 master's programmes, including around 80 taught in English.
- [Bachelor's studies](https://www.uu.se/en/study/bachelors-studies): Information about Uppsala's approximately 83 bachelor's programmes, including 8 in English.
- [Exchange studies](https://www.uu.se/en/study/exchange-studies): Information for incoming and outgoing exchange students.
- [Freestanding courses](https://www.uu.se/en/study/freestanding-courses): Approximately 1,600 freestanding courses, around 660 taught in English.
- [PhD studies](https://www.uu.se/en/study/phd-studies): Doctoral education in 152 subject areas.
- [Search courses and programmes](https://www.uu.se/en/study/search): Full searchable catalogue of all programmes and courses.
- [Why Uppsala University?](https://www.uu.se/en/study/why-uppsala-university): Reasons to choose Uppsala — quality, sustainability focus, student life.
- [Higher education in Sweden](https://www.uu.se/en/study/higher-education-in-sweden): How the Swedish higher education system works.
- [Study and live in Uppsala](https://www.uu.se/en/study/study-and-live-in-uppsala): Student life, housing, and the city of Uppsala.
- [Study and live in Visby](https://www.uu.se/en/study/study-and-live-in-visby): Life on Campus Gotland in Visby.
- [Traineeships and internships](https://www.uu.se/en/study/traineeships-and-internships): Information for incoming trainees.

## Students (current students)

- [Student gateway](https://www.uu.se/en/students): Starting point for all current students — registration, support, IT, student life, careers.
- [Admission and registration](https://www.uu.se/en/students/admission-and-registration): How to register, activate student accounts, and manage admission.
- [Support and services](https://www.uu.se/en/students/support-and-services): Study counselling, student health, disability support, and more.
- [IT for students](https://www.uu.se/en/students/it-for-students): Student IT systems, including Studium (the learning management system).
- [Student life](https://www.uu.se/en/students/student-life): Nations, clubs, sports, and social activities.
- [Your rights](https://www.uu.se/en/students/your-rights): Student rights and responsibilities at Uppsala University.
- [International opportunities](https://www.uu.se/en/students/international-opportunities): Exchange, scholarships, and global programmes for current students.
- [Degrees](https://www.uu.se/en/students/degrees): How to apply for a degree certificate.
- [Careers](https://www.uu.se/en/students/careers): Career guidance and employer contacts.

## Research

- [Research at Uppsala University](https://www.uu.se/en/research): Overview of research activities, strategy, and priorities.
- [Strong research environments](https://www.uu.se/en/research/strong-research-environments): Strategic research areas, Linnaeus Environments, and other major initiatives.
- [Research challenges](https://www.uu.se/en/research/research-challenges): Interdisciplinary research addressing major societal challenges.
- [Research projects](https://www.uu.se/en/research/research-projects): Searchable database of funded research projects.
- [Theses and publications](https://www.uu.se/en/research/theses-and-publications): Access to dissertations and scholarly publications from Uppsala.
- [Research funding](https://www.uu.se/en/research/research-funding): Main funding sources; approximately 58% of research externally funded.
- [Research ethics](https://www.uu.se/en/research/research-ethics): Uppsala University's approach to ethical research conduct.
- [Research infrastructure](https://www.uu.se/en/research/research-infrastructure): Major research facilities and shared infrastructure.
- [PhD studies (research)](https://www.uu.se/en/research/phd-studies): Doctoral education from the research perspective.
- [Research areas](https://www.uu.se/en/research/research-areas): The university's 50+ research areas listed by subject and department.
- [Uppsala University Future Institutes – UUniFI](https://www.uu.se/en/uunifi): Initiative for world-leading research into complex societal challenges.

## Collaboration and Innovation

- [Collaboration and innovation](https://www.uu.se/en/collaboration-innovation): How Uppsala University works with companies, organisations, and society.
- [Ways you can collaborate with us](https://www.uu.se/en/collaboration-innovation/ways-you-can-collaborate-with-us): Research collaboration, contract education, student recruitment, and more.
- [Innovation – our approach](https://www.uu.se/en/collaboration-innovation/innovation---our-approach): Support for idea development, IP, team-building, and funding.
- [Networks, partners and collaborations](https://www.uu.se/en/collaboration-innovation/networks-partners-and-collaborations): Strategic partnerships, national competence centres, and international collaborations.
- [Collaboration with Region Uppsala](https://www.uu.se/en/collaboration-innovation/networks-partners-and-collaborations/region-uppsala---our-largest-collaboration): The university's collaboration with Uppsala University Hospital (Akademiska sjukhuset).
- [Innovations from Uppsala University](https://www.uu.se/en/collaboration-innovation/innovation---our-approach/innovations-from-uppsala-university): Highlights of inventions and innovations originating from Uppsala research.
- [Uppsala University Alumni Network](https://www.uu.se/en/alumni): Global alumni network.

## Library

- [Uppsala University Library](https://www.uu.se/en/library): Sweden's largest research library, founded 1620, with 11 subject libraries.
- [Borrow and request](https://www.uu.se/en/library/borrow-and-request): Borrowing, interlibrary loans, and document delivery.
- [Finding materials](https://www.uu.se/en/library/finding-materials): Catalogue search, databases A–Z, and research guides.
- [Library instruction and support](https://www.uu.se/en/library/library-instruction-and-support): Courses, guides, and support for students and researchers.
- [Publish](https://www.uu.se/en/library/publish): Open access publishing, DiVA repository, and publication support.
- [Visit and contact](https://www.uu.se/en/library/visit-and-contact): Opening hours, locations, and contact information for all libraries.
- [About the Library](https://www.uu.se/en/library/about-the-library): History, mission, and organisation of Uppsala University Library.

## Cultural Heritage and Museums

- [Cultural heritage](https://www.uu.se/en/about-uu/cultural-heritage): Overview of Uppsala University's museums, music, and gardens.
- [Museums](https://www.uu.se/en/about-uu/cultural-heritage/museums): Overview of all university museums open to the public.
- [Museum of Evolution](https://www.uu.se/en/museum-of-evolution): Natural history museum with over 5 million specimens of fossils, minerals, animals, and plants.
- [Gustavianum](https://www.uu.se/en/gustavianum): Uppsala University Museum; Egyptian mummies, Viking-era finds, the Augsburg Art Cabinet, and an anatomical theatre from 1663.
- [Music](https://www.uu.se/en/about-uu/cultural-heritage/music): Music activities and ensembles at Uppsala University.
- [The Linnaeus Garden](https://www.uu.se/en/linnaeus-garden): Historic botanical garden where Carl Linnaeus lived and worked, with the Linnaeus Museum.
- [Linnaeus' Hammarby](https://www.uu.se/en/linnaeus-hammarby): Linnaeus' country estate outside Uppsala, now a museum.

## News, Events and Press

- [News](https://www.uu.se/en/news/all): Latest research news and university announcements.
- [Events](https://www.uu.se/en/events): Seminars, public lectures, and conferences.
- [Press](https://www.uu.se/en/press): Media contacts, press images, and press releases.

## Optional

- [Uppsala University Graduate School in Sustainability Studies – GRASS](https://www.uu.se/en/campus/gotland/research/grass): Graduate school in sustainability studies based at Campus Gotland.
- [Staff gateway](https://www.uu.se/en/staff): Information portal for employees at Uppsala University.
- [About this website](https://www.uu.se/en/about-website): Editorial policy, cookies, and technical information about uu.se.

Jobba hos oss

På Uppsala universitet pågår forskning som hjälper oss att förstå vårt samhälle, som gör världen bättre och livet enklare för många människor – forskning som ger nya perspektiv och kunskap som bidrar till miljöns hållbarhet, människans hälsa och samhällets utveckling.

Samarbeta med Uppsala universitet
